title: Message controls · Phase 2.1
description: Edit and resend, regenerate and retry replies, switch conversation versions, and copy or share messages.
notes: Phase 2.1 adds native message controls to Lumen.
Edit a prompt and resend it, regenerate a response, or retry a failed reply. Earlier transcripts stay available through the Versions control, and related versions appear together in history.
Copy messages or share them using the iPhone share sheet. Revisions save before a request starts and remain separate between accounts.
Cloud revisions retain existing project context, file metadata and citations while preserving the original conversation.
Includes two-size iPhone simulator journeys and Firebase SDK roundtrip checks for the original and revised transcripts.
